datasets.name: ODSTickets
datasets.sql:
select a.*,u.name tuser from sba_tm_archive a, user$ u
where 
(u.id=a.userid)
and (status in (select nvl(max (s.id),1) statusid from smart.tm_status s, sba_advanced_grants g, sba_usergrants_advanced a
                    where s.privname = g.grantname and g.id = a.advancedgrantid and username = user))

order by 1

datasets.name: ODSArchive
datasets.sql:
select a.status, a.id, a.pdate, a.pnum, a.dbankfilial, a.dbankcode, a.dbankname,
       a.dbankinn, a.dbankswift, a.dbankkacc, a.dacc_no, a.daccname,
       a.daccinn, a.kbankfilial, a.kbankcode, a.kbankname, a.kbankinn,
       a.kbankswift, a.kbankkacc, a.kbanksubkacc, a.kacc_no, a.kaccname,
       a.kaccinn, a.ammount, a.description, a.information, a.userid, u.name tuser
  from sba_tm_archive a, user$ u
 where (u.id=a.userid) order by a.id

datasets.name: ODSAccount
datasets.sql:
/* select a.id, a.name, a.acc_no, c.inn
    from account a, customers c
   where a.kli_id = c.id*/
  select a.id, a.name, a.acc_no, c.inn
    from account a, customers c
   where a.kli_id = c.id and a.kli_id=23745
     and a.close_dat is null
     and c.close_dat is null
order by acc_no

datasets.name: ODSBankM
datasets.sql: select id, bankcode||'-'||NVL (name, id || ' №-li Bank') bname,inn, swift, bankcode, krno, subkrno from bankm order by name

datasets.name: ODSAllTickets
datasets.sql: select a.rowid, a.* from tm_archive a

datasets.name: ODSforPrint
datasets.sql:
select a.status, a.id, a.pdate, a.pnum, a.dbankfilial, a.dbankcode, a.dbankname,
       a.dbankinn, a.dbankswift, a.dbankkacc, a.dacc_no, a.daccname,
       a.daccinn, a.kbankfilial, a.kbankcode, a.kbankname, a.kbankinn,
       a.kbankswift, a.kbankkacc, a.kbanksubkacc, a.kacc_no, a.kaccname,
       a.kaccinn, a.ammount, a.description, a.information, a.userid, u.name tuser
  from sba_tm_archive a, user$ u
 where (u.id=a.userid)
   and a.id = :id

datasets.name: ODSSettings
datasets.sql:
SELECT rowid, id, reportname, lblabel, lbtitle, lbdescr, lbbnumb,formatdat
  FROM tm_report_settings

datasets.name: ODSStatuses
datasets.sql:
select * from (select * from tm_status
where (id  <= (select nvl(max (s.id),6) statusid from smart.tm_status s, sba_advanced_grants g, sba_usergrants_advanced a
                    where s.privname = g.grantname and g.id = a.advancedgrantid and username = user))
union all 
select -1,'-','Hamısı' from dual)
order by id

datasets.name: ODSPaymentDecree
datasets.sql:
select a.id, a.pdate, a.pnum, a.dbankfilial, a.dbankcode, a.dbankname,
       a.dbankinn, a.dbankswift, a.dbankkacc, a.dacc_no, a.daccname,
       a.daccinn, a.kbankfilial, a.kbankcode, a.kbankname, a.kbankinn,
       a.kbankswift, a.kbankkacc, a.kbanksubkacc, a.kacc_no, a.kaccname,
       a.kaccinn, a.ammount, a.description, a.information, a.userid, a.status
  from sba_tm_archive a
 where a.id=:id
